reference: ngspice-46 4.8.3 with independently corrected body/NQS charge multiplicity, SI2019 host constants; not pristine original for affected scaling

b4noi.c.adaptation: Exact local N_DENS and Eval1ovFNoise; scoped full-node complex gain primitives, SI2019 host constants, numerical guards; simulator traversal and integration excluded.

chargeMultiplicityCorrection.reason: Current law mult_i*I and charge law mult_q*Q require matching equivalent RHS and analytic derivatives; original body and physical NQS couplings violate this when factors differ.

integrationAuthority: Public CoreSpice trapezoidal sampled output PSD, not ngspice native Nintegrate

cases.name: 1-t0-f0
cases.source:
Native BSIM4 independent noise 1-t0-f0
.options bsim4stressiterations=8
.temp 27
.model process nmos level=54 version=4.8.3 vth0=0.7 u0=.05 toxe=10n
+ tnoimod=0 fnoimod=0 kf=1e-25 capmod=2 rsh=20
VD supply 0 2
RL supply d 1k
VG g 0 1.2 ac 1
VS s 0 0
VB b 0 -0.1
M1 d g s b process l=1u w=10u ad=2p as=3p pd=12u ps=14u nrd=1 nrs=1

.end
